clauses.heading: Agreement
clauses.text: In return for the premium and your compliance with the provisions of this policy, we will provide the insurance described in this policy.

clauses.heading: Agreement
clauses.text: This policy consists of the Declarations, this form, and any endorsements listed in the Declarations. Where an endorsement conflicts with this form, the endorsement controls.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “You” and “your” mean the named insured shown in the Declarations and the spouse or domestic partner of the named insured, if a resident of the same household.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “We”, “us” and “our” mean the company providing this insurance.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Actual cash value” means the cost to replace damaged property with new property of like kind and quality, less a deduction for physical deterioration, wear and obsolescence.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Aircraft” means any contrivance used or designed for flight, including an unmanned aircraft or drone, except a model or hobby aircraft weighing less than 0.55 pounds that is not used or designed to carry people or cargo.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Bodily injury” means bodily harm, sickness or disease, including required care, loss of services and death that results. It does not include emotional distress unless it results from bodily harm.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Business
clauses.text: “Business” means a trade, profession or occupation engaged in on a full-time, part-time or occasional basis.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Business
clauses.text: “Business” also means any other activity engaged in for money or other compensation, except the activities listed in 6.c.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Business
clauses.text: “Business” does not include: (1) one or more activities for which no “insured” received more than $3,000 in total compensation during the 12 months before the beginning of the policy period; (2) volunteer activities for which no money is received other than payment of expenses; or (3) providing home day care services to a relative of an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Employee” means an employee of an “insured”, or a worker leased to an “insured” by a labor leasing firm, other than a “residence employee”.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Fungi” means any type or form of fungus, including mold or mildew, and any mycotoxins, spores, scents or byproducts produced or released by fungi.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Insured
clauses.text: “Insured” means you and residents of your household who are your relatives, or other persons under the age of 21 in the care of any person named above.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Insured
clauses.text: “Insured” also means a full-time student, enrolled in school and away from your residence to attend it, who was a resident of your household before leaving, if the student is under the age of 24 and is your relative, or is under the age of 21 and in your care or the care of a resident relative.

clauses.heading: Definitions > Insured
clauses.text: Under Section II, “insured” also means any person or organization legally responsible for animals or watercraft to which this policy applies and that are owned by an “insured”, except a person or organization using or having custody of them in the course of a “business” or without the owner's consent.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Insured location” means: (a) the “residence premises”; (b) the part of other premises, structures and grounds used by you as a residence that is shown in the Declarations or acquired by you during the policy period for your use as a residence; (c) any premises used by you in connection with (a) or (b); (d) any part of a premises not owned by an “insured” where an “insured” is temporarily residing; (e) vacant land, other than farm land, owned by or rented to an “insured”; (f) land owned by or rented to an “insured” on which a one- to four-family dwelling is being built as a residence for an “insured”; (g) individual or family cemetery plots or burial vaults of an “insured”; or (h) any part of a premises occasionally rented to an “insured” for other than “business” use.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Motor vehicle” means a self-propelled land or amphibious vehicle, or any trailer or semitrailer while being carried on, towed by or hitched to such a vehicle. It does not include a motorized land vehicle designed for assisting the disabled, or one used solely to service the “residence premises”, such as a riding lawn mower, while not licensed for road use.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Occurrence” means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions, which results during the policy period in “bodily injury” or “property damage”.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Property damage” means physical injury to, destruction of, or loss of use of tangible property.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Residence employee” means an employee of an “insured”, or a worker leased to an “insured”, whose duties relate to the maintenance or use of the “residence premises”, including household or domestic services, or who performs similar duties elsewhere not related to the “business” of an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Residence premises” means the one-family dwelling where you reside, or the two-, three- or four-family dwelling where you reside in at least one of the family units, or that part of any other building where you reside, and which is shown as the “residence premises” in the Declarations. It includes the other structures and grounds at that location.

clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: “Vacant” means that the dwelling has no occupants and does not contain enough personal property to make it reasonably fit for its customary occupancy. A dwelling being constructed is not considered “vacant”. A dwelling that contains furnishings but whose occupants are temporarily away is unoccupied, not “vacant”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage A - Dwelling
clauses.text: We cover the dwelling on the “residence premises” shown in the Declarations, including structures attached to the dwelling, and fixtures, wiring, plumbing and built-in appliances that are part of it.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage A - Dwelling
clauses.text: We also cover materials and supplies located on or next to the “residence premises” used to construct, alter or repair the dwelling or other structures on the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage A - Dwelling
clauses.text: We do not cover land, including the land on which the dwelling is located, or the cost to restore, stabilize or replace land.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: We cover other structures on the “residence premises” that are set apart from the dwelling by clear space, such as a detached garage, shed, fence or gazebo. Structures connected to the dwelling only by a fence, utility line or similar connection are other structures.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: We do not cover land, including the land on which the other structures are located.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: We do not cover other structures rented or held for rental to any person not a tenant of the dwelling, unless used solely as a private garage.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: We do not cover other structures from which any “business” is conducted, or used to store “business” property. We do cover a structure that contains “business” property solely owned by an “insured” or a tenant of the dwelling, provided that the property does not include gaseous or liquid fuel other than fuel in a permanently installed fuel tank of a vehicle or craft parked or stored in the structure.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: The limit of liability for Coverage B is 10% of the Coverage A limit unless another amount is shown in the Declarations. Use of this coverage does not reduce the Coverage A limit.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: We cover personal property owned or used by an “insured” while it is anywhere in the world. At your request, we will also cover personal property owned by others while the property is on the part of the “residence premises” occupied by an “insured”, and personal property owned by a guest or a “residence employee” while the property is in any residence occupied by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Our limit of liability for personal property usually located at an “insured's” residence, other than the “residence premises”, is 10% of the limit of liability for Coverage C, or $1,000, whichever is greater. This limitation does not apply to personal property moved from the “residence premises” because it is being repaired, renovated or rebuilt and is not fit to live in or store property in.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: The special limits below are the most we will pay for each loss for all property in each category. These special limits do not increase the Coverage C limit of liability.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $250 on money, bank notes, bullion, gold other than goldware, silver other than silverware, platinum other than platinumware, coins, medals, scrip, stored value cards and smart cards.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 on securities, accounts, deeds, evidences of debt, letters of credit, notes other than bank notes, manuscripts, personal records, passports, tickets and stamps. This dollar limit applies regardless of the medium on which the material exists, and includes the cost to research, replace or restore the information.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 on watercraft of all types, including their trailers, furnishings, equipment and outboard engines or motors.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 on trailers or semitrailers not used with watercraft of all types.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 for loss by theft of jewelry, watches, furs, and precious and semiprecious stones.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $2,500 for loss by theft of firearms and related equipment.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $2,500 for loss by theft of silverware, silver-plated ware, goldware, gold-plated ware, platinumware, platinum-plated ware and pewterware.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $2,500 on property, on the “residence premises”, used primarily for “business” purposes.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 on property, away from the “residence premises”, used primarily for “business” purposes.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Special Limits of Liability
clauses.text: $1,500 on portable electronic equipment that reproduces, receives or transmits audio, visual or data signals and is designed to be operated by more than one power source, one of which is a “motor vehicle's” electrical system, while the equipment is in or upon a “motor vehicle”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: We do not cover the property listed in 4.a through 4.j.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Articles separately described and specifically insured, regardless of the limit for which they are insured, in this or other insurance.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Animals, birds or fish.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: “Motor vehicles”, including their parts, equipment and accessories, and electronic apparatus permanently installed in them. We do cover “motor vehicles” not required to be registered for use on public roads that are used solely to service the “residence premises” or designed to assist the disabled.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: “Aircraft”, meaning any contrivance used or designed for flight, including any parts whether or not attached, except model or hobby aircraft not used or designed to carry people or cargo.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Property of roomers, boarders and other tenants, except property of roomers and boarders related to an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Property in an apartment regularly rented or held for rental to others by an “insured”, except as provided under Landlord's Furnishings in the Additional Coverages.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Property rented or held for rental to others off the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: “Business” data, including such data stored in books of account, drawings, paper records or electronic media. We do cover the cost of blank recording or storage media and of prerecorded computer programs available on the retail market.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Credit cards, electronic fund transfer cards or access devices used solely for deposit, withdrawal or transfer of funds, except as provided under the Additional Coverages.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage C - Personal Property > Property Not Covered
clauses.text: Water or steam.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage D - Loss of Use
clauses.text: Additional Living Expense. If a loss covered under Section I makes that part of the “residence premises” where you reside not fit to live in, we cover any necessary increase in living expenses incurred by you so that your household can maintain its normal standard of living. Payment will be for the shortest time required to repair or replace the damage or, if you permanently relocate, the shortest time required for your household to settle elsewhere.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage D - Loss of Use
clauses.text: Fair Rental Value. If a loss covered under Section I makes that part of the “residence premises” rented to others or held for rental by you not fit to live in, we cover the fair rental value of that part, less any expenses that do not continue while it is not fit to live in, for the shortest time required to repair or replace it.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage D - Loss of Use
clauses.text: Civil Authority Prohibits Use. If a civil authority prohibits you from use of the “residence premises” as a result of direct damage to neighboring premises by a peril insured against, we cover the loss as provided in D.1 and D.2 for no more than two weeks.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Coverage D - Loss of Use
clauses.text: The periods of time under Coverage D are not limited by expiration of this policy. We do not cover loss or expense due to cancellation of a lease or agreement.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Debris Removal
clauses.text: We will pay your reasonable expense for the removal of debris of covered property if a peril insured against that applies to the damaged property causes the loss, and of ash, dust or particles from a volcanic eruption that has caused direct loss to a building or property contained in a building. This expense is included in the limit of liability that applies to the damaged property; if the amount paid for the damage plus the debris removal exceeds that limit, an additional 5% of that limit is available for debris removal expense.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Debris Removal
clauses.text: We will also pay your reasonable expense, up to $1,000, for the removal from the “residence premises” of your trees felled by the peril of windstorm or hail or weight of ice, snow or sleet, or a neighbor's trees felled by a peril insured against under Coverage C, provided the trees damage a covered structure or block a driveway on the “residence premises” preventing a “motor vehicle” from entering or leaving, or block a ramp designed to assist the handicapped. The $1,000 limit is the most we will pay in any one loss, regardless of the number of fallen trees, and no more than $500 of it will be paid for the removal of any one tree.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Reasonable Repairs
clauses.text: We will pay the reasonable cost incurred by you for the necessary measures taken solely to protect covered property that is damaged by a peril insured against from further damage. This coverage does not increase the limit of liability that applies to the property being repaired, and does not relieve you of your duty to protect the property from further damage.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Trees, Shrubs and Other Plants
clauses.text: We cover trees, shrubs, plants or lawns on the “residence premises” for loss caused by the following perils only: fire or lightning, explosion, riot or civil commotion, aircraft, vehicles not owned or operated by a resident of the “residence premises”, vandalism or malicious mischief, or theft. We will pay up to 5% of the Coverage A limit for all trees, shrubs, plants or lawns, but no more than $500 for any one tree, shrub or plant. We do not cover property grown for “business” purposes.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Fire Department Service Charge
clauses.text: We will pay up to $500 for your liability assumed by contract or agreement for fire department charges incurred when the fire department is called to save or protect covered property from a peril insured against. We do not cover fire department service charges if the property is located within the limits of the city, municipality or protection district furnishing the fire department response. No deductible applies to this coverage.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Property Removed
clauses.text: We insure covered property against direct loss from any cause while being removed from a premises endangered by a peril insured against and for no more than 30 days while removed.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Credit Card, Fund Transfer Card, Forgery and Counterfeit Money
clauses.text: We will pay up to $500 for the legal obligation of an “insured” to pay because of the theft or unauthorized use of credit cards or fund transfer cards issued to or registered in an “insured's” name; loss resulting from forgery or alteration of any check or negotiable instrument; and loss resulting from acceptance in good faith of counterfeit money. We do not cover use of a card by a resident of your household, by a person who has been entrusted with the card, or if an “insured” has not complied with all terms and conditions under which the card is issued. No deductible applies to this coverage.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Loss Assessment
clauses.text: We will pay up to $1,000 for your share of a loss assessment charged during the policy period against you, as owner or tenant of the “residence premises”, by a corporation or association of property owners, when the assessment is made as a result of direct loss to property owned by all members collectively, caused by a peril insured against under Coverage A, other than earthquake or land shock waves accompanying a volcanic eruption.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Collapse
clauses.text: Collapse means an abrupt falling down or caving in of a building or any part of a building with the result that the building or part of the building cannot be occupied for its current intended purpose. A building or part of a building that is in danger of falling down or caving in, or that is standing, is not considered to be in a state of collapse, even if it shows evidence of cracking, bulging, sagging, bending, leaning, settling, shrinkage or expansion.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Collapse
clauses.text: We insure for direct physical loss to covered property involving collapse of a building or any part of a building if the collapse was caused by one or more of the following: the perils insured against under Coverage C; decay, or insect or vermin damage, hidden from view, unless its presence was known to an “insured” before the collapse; weight of contents, equipment, animals or people; weight of rain which collects on a roof; or use of defective material or methods in construction, remodeling or renovation if the collapse occurs during the course of that work.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Collapse
clauses.text: Loss to an awning, fence, patio, deck, pavement, swimming pool, underground pipe, flue, drain, cesspool, septic tank, foundation, retaining wall, bulkhead, pier, wharf or dock is not included under 8.b unless the loss is a direct result of the collapse of a building or any part of a building. This coverage does not increase the limit of liability that applies to the damaged covered property.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Glass or Safety Glazing Material
clauses.text: We cover the breakage of glass or safety glazing material which is part of a covered building, storm door or storm window, and the direct physical loss to covered property caused solely by the pieces, fragments or splinters of broken glass. We do not cover loss on the “residence premises” if the dwelling has been “vacant” for more than 60 consecutive days immediately before the loss, except when the breakage results directly from earth movement.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Landlord's Furnishings
clauses.text: We will pay up to $2,500 for your appliances, carpeting and other household furnishings in each apartment on the “residence premises” regularly rented or held for rental to others by an “insured”, for loss caused by a peril listed under Coverage C other than theft.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Ordinance or Law
clauses.text: You may use up to 10% of the limit of liability that applies to Coverage A for the increased costs you incur due to the enforcement of any ordinance or law which requires or regulates the construction, demolition, remodeling, renovation or repair of that part of a covered building or other structure damaged by a peril insured against, including the costs to demolish and remove the undamaged part when the law requires it. We do not cover the loss in value of a covered building due to the requirements of any ordinance or law, or the costs to comply with any law requiring the testing, cleanup or removal of pollutants. This coverage is additional insurance.

clauses.heading: Section I - Property Coverages > Additional Coverages > Grave Markers
clauses.text: We will pay up to $5,000 for grave markers, including mausoleums, on or away from the “residence premises” for loss caused by a peril listed under Coverage C.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures
clauses.text: We insure against direct physical loss to property described in Coverages A and B. We do not insure, however, for loss excluded under Section I - Exclusions, or for loss described in A.2 below.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss involving collapse, including any of the following conditions of property or any part of the property: abrupt falling down or caving in; loss of structural integrity, including separation of parts of the property or property in danger of falling down or caving in; or any cracking, bulging, sagging, bending, leaning, settling, shrinkage or expansion as such condition relates to collapse. This does not apply to the extent coverage is provided under Additional Coverage 8, Collapse.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by freezing of a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or of a household appliance, or by discharge, leakage or overflow from within the system or appliance caused by freezing. This does not apply if you have used reasonable care to maintain heat in the building, or to shut off the water supply and drain all systems and appliances of water.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by freezing, thawing, pressure or weight of water or ice, whether driven by wind or not, to a fence, pavement, patio or swimming pool, footing, foundation, bulkhead, wall or any other structure or device that supports all or part of a building or other structure, a retaining wall or bulkhead that does not support all or part of a building or other structure, or a pier, wharf or dock.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by theft in or to a dwelling under construction, or of materials and supplies for use in the construction, until the dwelling is finished and occupied.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by vandalism and malicious mischief, and any ensuing loss caused by any intentional and wrongful act committed in the course of the vandalism or malicious mischief, if the dwelling has been “vacant” for more than 60 consecutive days immediately before the loss. A dwelling being constructed is not considered “vacant”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by mold, “fungi” or wet rot. However, we do insure for loss caused by mold, “fungi” or wet rot that is hidden within the walls or ceilings or beneath the floors or above the ceilings of a structure if such loss results from the accidental discharge or overflow of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system, or a household appliance, on the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by wear and tear, marring or deterioration.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by mechanical breakdown, latent defect, inherent vice, or any quality in property that causes it to damage or destroy itself.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by smog, rust or other corrosion, or dry rot.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by smoke from agricultural smudging or industrial operations.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by discharge, dispersal, seepage, migration, release or escape of pollutants, unless the discharge is itself caused by a peril insured against named under Coverage C. Pollutants means any solid, liquid, gaseous or thermal irritant or contaminant, including smoke, vapor, soot, fumes, acids, alkalis, chemicals and waste.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by settling, shrinking, bulging or expansion, including resultant cracking, of bulkheads, pavements, patios, footings, foundations, walls, floors, roofs or ceilings.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by birds, rodents or insects.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by nesting or infestation, or discharge or release of waste products or secretions, by any animals; or by animals owned or kept by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Losses Not Insured
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by constant or repeated seepage or leakage of water or the presence or condensation of humidity, moisture or vapor, over a period of weeks, months or years, unless such seepage or leakage of water or the presence or condensation of humidity, moisture or vapor and the resulting damage is unknown to all “insureds” and is hidden within the walls or ceilings or beneath the floors or above the ceilings of a structure.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage A - Dwelling and Coverage B - Other Structures > Ensuing Loss
clauses.text: Under 2.b and 2.g above, any ensuing loss to property described in Coverages A and B not precluded by any other provision in this policy is covered. If any of 2.g.1 through 2.g.9 causes water damage not otherwise excluded, from a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or household appliance, we cover loss caused by the water, including the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of a building, or other structure, on the “residence premises”, but only when necessary to repair the system or appliance. We do not cover loss to the system or appliance from which this water escaped.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: We insure for direct physical loss to the property described in Coverage C caused by any of the following perils unless the loss is excluded in Section I - Exclusions.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Fire or lightning.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Windstorm or hail. This peril does not include loss to property contained in a building caused by rain, snow, sleet, sand or dust unless the direct force of wind or hail damages the building causing an opening in a roof or wall and the rain, snow, sleet, sand or dust enters through this opening. This peril includes loss to watercraft of all types and their trailers, furnishings, equipment and outboard engines or motors only while inside a fully enclosed building.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Explosion.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Riot or civil commotion.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Aircraft, including self-propelled missiles and spacecraft.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Vehicles.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Smoke, meaning sudden and accidental damage from smoke, including the emission or puffback of smoke, soot, fumes or vapors from a boiler, furnace or related equipment. This peril does not include loss caused by smoke from agricultural smudging or industrial operations, or from a fireplace.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Vandalism or malicious mischief.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property > Theft
clauses.text: Theft, including attempted theft and loss of property from a known place when it is likely that the property has been stolen.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property > Theft
clauses.text: The theft peril does not include loss caused by theft committed by an “insured”; in or to a dwelling under construction, or of materials and supplies for use in the construction, until the dwelling is finished and occupied; or from that part of a “residence premises” rented by an “insured” to someone other than another “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property > Theft
clauses.text: The theft peril does not include loss caused by theft that occurs off the “residence premises” of property while at any other residence owned by, rented to, or occupied by an “insured”, except while an “insured” is temporarily living there; of property while in any other residence owned by, rented to or occupied by an “insured” who is a student, unless the student was at that residence within 60 days before the loss; of watercraft of all types, and their furnishings, equipment and outboard engines or motors; or of trailers, semitrailers and campers.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Falling objects. This peril does not include loss to property contained in a building unless the roof or an outside wall of the building is first damaged by a falling object. Damage to the falling object itself is not included.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Weight of ice, snow or sleet which causes damage to property contained in a building.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Accidental discharge or overflow of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or from within a household appliance. This peril does not include loss to the system or appliance from which the water or steam escaped; loss caused by or resulting from freezing except as provided in peril 14; or loss on the “residence premises” caused by accidental discharge or overflow which occurs off the “residence premises”. A plumbing system or household appliance does not include a sump, sump pump or related equipment, or a roof drain, gutter, downspout or similar fixtures or equipment.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Sudden and accidental tearing apart, cracking, burning or bulging of a steam or hot water heating system, an air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system, or an appliance for heating water. We do not cover loss caused by or resulting from freezing under this peril.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Freezing of a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or of a household appliance, but only if you have used reasonable care to maintain heat in the building, or to shut off the water supply and drain all systems and appliances of water.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Sudden and accidental damage from artificially generated electrical current. This peril does not include loss to tubes, transistors, electronic components or circuitry that is a part of appliances, fixtures, computers, home entertainment units or other types of electronic apparatus.

clauses.heading: Section I - Perils Insured Against > Coverage C - Personal Property
clauses.text: Volcanic eruption, other than loss caused by earthquake, land shock waves or tremors.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused directly or indirectly by any of the following. Such loss is excluded regardless of any other cause or event contributing concurrently or in any sequence to the loss. These exclusions apply whether or not the event results in widespread damage or affects a substantial area.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Ordinance or Law
clauses.text: Ordinance or Law, meaning any ordinance or law requiring or regulating the construction, demolition, remodeling, renovation or repair of property, including removal of any resulting debris, or resulting in a loss in value of property. This exclusion does not apply to the extent coverage is provided under Additional Coverage 11, Ordinance or Law.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Earth Movement
clauses.text: Earth Movement, meaning earthquake, including land shock waves or tremors before, during or after a volcanic eruption; landslide, mudslide or mudflow; subsidence or sinkhole; or any other earth movement including earth sinking, rising or shifting. This exclusion applies whether the earth movement is caused by or results from human or animal forces or any act of nature. However, direct loss by fire, explosion or breakage of glass or safety glazing material resulting from earth movement is covered.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Water
clauses.text: Water, meaning any of 3.a through 3.c below. This exclusion applies regardless of whether any of these is caused by an act of nature or is otherwise caused, and applies to, but is not limited to, escape, overflow or discharge, for any reason, of water or waterborne material from a dam, levee, seawall or any other boundary or containment system.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Water
clauses.text: Flood, surface water, waves, including tidal wave and tsunami, tides, tidal water, overflow of any body of water, or spray from any of these, all whether or not driven by wind, including storm surge.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Water
clauses.text: Water or waterborne material which backs up through sewers or drains, or which overflows or is otherwise discharged from a sump, sump pump or related equipment.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Water
clauses.text: Water or waterborne material below the surface of the ground, including water which exerts pressure on, or seeps, leaks or flows through, a building, sidewalk, driveway, patio, foundation, swimming pool or other structure.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Water
clauses.text: Direct loss by fire, explosion or theft resulting from any of 3.a through 3.c is covered.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Power Failure
clauses.text: Power Failure, meaning the failure of power or other utility service if the failure takes place off the “residence premises”. But if the failure results in a loss, from a peril insured against, on the “residence premises”, we will pay for the loss caused by that peril.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Neglect
clauses.text: Neglect, meaning neglect of an “insured” to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > War
clauses.text: War, including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion or revolution, warlike act by a military force or military personnel, and destruction, seizure or use for a military purpose. Discharge of a nuclear weapon is deemed a warlike act even if accidental.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Nuclear Hazard
clauses.text: Nuclear Hazard, meaning any nuclear reaction, radiation or radioactive contamination, all whether controlled or uncontrolled or however caused, or any consequence of any of these. Loss caused by the nuclear hazard is not considered loss caused by fire, explosion or smoke. Direct loss by fire resulting from the nuclear hazard is covered.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Intentional Loss
clauses.text: Intentional Loss, meaning any loss arising out of any act an “insured” commits or conspires to commit with the intent to cause a loss. In the event of such loss, no “insured” is entitled to coverage, even “insureds” who did not commit or conspire to commit the act causing the loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Governmental Action
clauses.text: Governmental Action, meaning the destruction, confiscation or seizure of property described in Coverage A, B or C by order of any governmental or public authority. This exclusion does not apply to such acts ordered by any governmental or public authority that are taken at the time of a fire to prevent its spread, if the loss caused by fire would be covered under this policy.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss to property described in Coverages A and B caused by any of B.10 through B.12 below. However, any ensuing loss to property described in Coverages A and B not precluded by any other provision in this policy is covered.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Weather Conditions
clauses.text: Weather conditions. This exclusion only applies if weather conditions contribute in any way with a cause or event excluded in A above to produce the loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Acts or Decisions
clauses.text: Acts or decisions, including the failure to act or decide, of any person, group, organization or governmental body.

clauses.heading: Section I - Exclusions > Faulty, Inadequate or Defective Work
clauses.text: Faulty, inadequate or defective planning, zoning, development, surveying or siting; design, specifications, workmanship, repair, construction, renovation, remodeling, grading or compaction; materials used in repair, construction, renovation or remodeling; or maintenance, of part or all of any property whether on or off the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Insurable Interest and Limit of Liability
clauses.text: Even if more than one person has an insurable interest in the property covered, we will not be liable in any one loss for more than the amount of an “insured's” interest at the time of loss, or for more than the applicable limit of liability.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Deductible
clauses.text: Unless otherwise noted in this policy, the following deductible provision applies: with respect to any one loss, subject to the applicable limit of liability, we will pay only that part of the total of all loss payable that exceeds the deductible amount shown in the Declarations.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: In case of a loss to covered property, we have no duty to provide coverage under this policy if the failure to comply with the duties in 3.a through 3.g is prejudicial to us. These duties must be performed either by you, an “insured” seeking coverage, or a representative of either.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Give prompt notice to us or our agent.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Notify the police in case of loss by theft.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Notify the credit card or electronic fund transfer card company in case of loss as provided for in Additional Coverage 6.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Protect the property from further damage, make reasonable and necessary repairs to protect the property, and keep an accurate record of repair expenses.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Prepare an inventory of damaged personal property showing the quantity, description, actual cash value and amount of loss, and attach all bills, receipts and related documents that justify the figures in the inventory.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: As often as we reasonably require, show the damaged property, provide us with records and documents we request and permit us to make copies, and submit to examination under oath, while not in the presence of another “insured”, and sign the same.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Duties After Loss
clauses.text: Send to us, within 60 days after our request, your signed, sworn proof of loss which sets forth, to the best of your knowledge and belief, the time and cause of loss, the interests in the property, other insurance, changes in title or occupancy during the policy period, specifications of damaged buildings, the inventory of damaged personal property, and receipts for additional living expenses.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: In this condition, the terms “cost to repair or replace” and “replacement cost” do not include the increased costs incurred to comply with the enforcement of any ordinance or law, except to the extent that coverage for these increased costs is provided in Additional Coverage 11. Covered property losses are settled as described in 4.a through 4.e.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: Property of the following types is settled at “actual cash value” at the time of loss but not more than the amount required to repair or replace: personal property; awnings, carpeting, household appliances, outdoor antennas and outdoor equipment, whether or not attached to buildings; structures that are not buildings; and grave markers, including mausoleums.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: Buildings covered under Coverage A or B are settled at replacement cost without deduction for depreciation, subject to the following: if, at the time of loss, the amount of insurance in this policy on the damaged building is 80% or more of the full replacement cost of the building immediately before the loss, we will pay the cost to repair or replace, without deduction for depreciation, but not more than the least of the limit of liability under this policy that applies to the building, the replacement cost of that part of the building damaged with material of like kind and quality and for like use, or the necessary amount actually spent to repair or replace the damaged building.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: If, at the time of loss, the amount of insurance in this policy on the damaged building is less than 80% of the full replacement cost of the building immediately before the loss, we will pay the greater of the “actual cash value” of that part of the building damaged, or that proportion of the cost to repair or replace, without deduction for depreciation, which the total amount of insurance in this policy on the damaged building bears to 80% of the replacement cost of the building.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: We will pay no more than the “actual cash value” of the damage until actual repair or replacement is complete. Once actual repair or replacement is complete, we will settle the loss according to 4.b or 4.c. However, if the cost to repair or replace the damage is both less than 5% of the amount of insurance in this policy on the building and less than $2,500, we will settle the loss according to 4.b or 4.c whether or not actual repair or replacement is complete.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: You may disregard the replacement cost loss settlement provisions and make claim under this policy for loss to buildings on an “actual cash value” basis. You may then make claim for any additional liability according to 4.b or 4.c, provided you notify us of your intent to do so within 180 days after the date of loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss to a Pair or Set
clauses.text: In case of loss to a pair or set we may elect to repair or replace any part to restore the pair or set to its value before the loss, or to pay the difference between the “actual cash value” of the property before and after the loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Appraisal
clauses.text: If you and we fail to agree on the amount of loss, either may demand an appraisal of the loss. In this event, each party will choose a competent and impartial appraiser within 20 days after receiving a written request from the other. The two appraisers will choose an umpire; if they cannot agree upon an umpire within 15 days, you or we may request that the choice be made by a judge of a court of record in the state where the “residence premises” is located. The appraisers will separately set the amount of loss. If the appraisers submit a written report of an agreement to us, the amount agreed upon will be the amount of loss. If they fail to agree, they will submit their differences to the umpire, and a decision agreed to by any two will set the amount of loss. Each party will pay its own appraiser and bear the other expenses of the appraisal and umpire equally.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Other Insurance and Service Agreement
clauses.text: If a loss covered by this policy is also covered by other insurance, we will pay only the proportion of the loss that the limit of liability that applies under this policy bears to the total amount of insurance covering the loss. If a loss covered by this policy is also covered by a service agreement, this insurance is excess over any amounts payable under the service agreement.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Suit Against Us
clauses.text: No action can be brought against us unless there has been full compliance with all of the terms under Section I of this policy and the action is started within two years after the date of loss.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Our Option
clauses.text: If we give you written notice within 30 days after we receive your signed, sworn proof of loss, we may repair or replace any part of the damaged property with material or property of like kind and quality.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Payment
clauses.text: We will adjust all losses with you. We will pay you unless some other person is named in the policy or is legally entitled to receive payment. Loss will be payable 60 days after we receive your proof of loss and reach an agreement with you, there is an entry of a final judgment, or there is a filing of an appraisal award with us.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Abandonment of Property
clauses.text: We need not accept any property abandoned by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Mortgage Clause
clauses.text: If a mortgagee is named in this policy, any loss payable under Coverage A or B will be paid to the mortgagee and you, as interests appear. If we deny your claim, that denial will not apply to a valid claim of the mortgagee if the mortgagee notifies us of any change in ownership, occupancy or substantial change in risk of which the mortgagee is aware, pays any premium due under this policy on demand if you have neglected to pay the premium, and submits a signed, sworn statement of loss within 60 days after receiving notice from us of your failure to do so.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > No Benefit to Bailee
clauses.text: We will not recognize any assignment or grant any coverage that benefits a person or organization holding, storing or moving property for a fee regardless of any other provision of this policy.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Recovered Property
clauses.text: If you or we recover any property for which we have made payment under this policy, you or we will notify the other of the recovery. At your option, the property will be returned to or retained by you or it will become our property. If the recovered property is returned to or retained by you, the loss payment will be adjusted based on the amount you received for the recovered property.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Volcanic Eruption Period
clauses.text: One or more volcanic eruptions that occur within a 72-hour period will be considered as one volcanic eruption.

clauses.heading: Section I - Conditions > Loss Payable Clause
clauses.text: If the Declarations show a loss payee for certain listed insured personal property, the definition of “insured” is changed to include that loss payee with respect to that property. If we decide to cancel or not renew this policy, that loss payee will be notified in writing.

clauses.heading: Section II - Liability Coverages > Coverage E - Personal Liability
clauses.text: If a claim is made or a suit is brought against an “insured” for damages because of “bodily injury” or “property damage” caused by an “occurrence” to which this coverage applies, we will pay up to our limit of liability for the damages for which an “insured” is legally liable, and provide a defense at our expense by counsel of our choice, even if the suit is groundless, false or fraudulent. We may investigate and settle any claim or suit that we decide is appropriate. Our duty to settle or defend ends when our limit of liability for the “occurrence” has been exhausted by payment of a judgment or settlement.

clauses.heading: Section II - Liability Coverages > Coverage F - Medical Payments to Others
clauses.text: We will pay the necessary medical expenses that are incurred or medically ascertained within three years from the date of an accident causing “bodily injury”. This coverage does not apply to you or regular residents of your household except “residence employees”. As to others, this coverage applies only to a person on the “insured location” with the permission of an “insured”, or to a person off the “insured location” if the “bodily injury” arises out of a condition on the “insured location”, is caused by the activities of an “insured” or a “residence employee” in the course of employment, or is caused by an animal owned by or in the care of an “insured”. Payment is made regardless of whether an “insured” is legally liable.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Motor Vehicle Liability
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to any “motor vehicle liability” if, at the time and place of an “occurrence”, the involved “motor vehicle” is registered for use on public roads or property, is not registered but is required by law to be registered, or is being used to carry persons or cargo for a charge or in any race or speed contest. Motor vehicle liability means liability arising out of the ownership, maintenance, use, loading or unloading, or entrustment of a “motor vehicle”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Watercraft Liability
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to any liability arising out of watercraft owned by or rented to an “insured” if the watercraft is a sailing vessel 26 feet or more in overall length, or is powered by inboard or outboard engines or motors with more than 50 total horsepower, or if the watercraft is being used to carry persons or cargo for a charge or in any race or speed contest.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Aircraft Liability
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to any liability arising out of the ownership, maintenance, use, loading or unloading, or entrustment by an “insured” of an “aircraft”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Hovercraft Liability
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to any liability arising out of the ownership, maintenance, use, loading or unloading, or entrustment by an “insured” of a hovercraft, meaning a self-propelled motorized ground effect vehicle.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Expected or Intended Injury
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” which is expected or intended by an “insured”, even if the resulting injury or damage is of a different kind, quality or degree than initially expected or intended, or is sustained by a different person or entity than initially expected or intended. This exclusion does not apply to “bodily injury” resulting from the use of reasonable force by an “insured” to protect persons or property.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Business
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” arising out of or in connection with a “business” conducted from an “insured location” or engaged in by an “insured”, whether or not the “business” is owned or operated by an “insured” or employs an “insured”. This exclusion applies but is not limited to an act or omission, regardless of its nature or circumstance, involving a service or duty rendered, promised, owed, or implied to be provided because of the nature of the “business”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Business
clauses.text: The business exclusion does not apply to the rental or holding for rental of an “insured location” on an occasional basis if used only as a residence; in part for use only as a residence, unless a single-family unit is intended for use by the occupying family to lodge more than two roomers or boarders; or in part, as an office, school, studio or private garage.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Business
clauses.text: The business exclusion does not apply to an “insured” under the age of 21 years involved in a part-time or occasional, self-employed “business” with no employees.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Professional Services
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” arising out of the rendering of or failure to render professional services.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Uninsured Premises
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” arising out of a premises owned by an “insured”, rented to an “insured”, or rented to others by an “insured”, that is not an “insured location”. This exclusion does not apply to “bodily injury” to a “residence employee” arising out of and in the course of the “residence employee's” employment by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > War
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” caused directly or indirectly by war, including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion or revolution, warlike act by a military force or military personnel, or destruction, seizure or use for a military purpose.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Communicable Disease
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” which arises out of the transmission of a communicable disease by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Sexual Molestation, Corporal Punishment or Abuse
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” arising out of sexual molestation, corporal punishment or physical or mental abuse.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Controlled Substance
clauses.text: Coverages E and F do not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” arising out of the use, sale, manufacture, delivery, transfer or possession by any person of a controlled substance as defined by federal law, other than the legitimate use of prescription drugs by a person following the orders of a licensed health care professional.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Contractual Liability
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to liability for your share of any loss assessment charged against all members of an association, corporation or community of property owners, except as provided in Section II Additional Coverage 4; or under any contract or agreement entered into by an “insured”, except written contracts that directly relate to the ownership, maintenance or use of an “insured location”, or where the liability of others is assumed by you prior to an “occurrence”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Property Owned by an Insured
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to “property damage” to property owned by an “insured”. This includes costs or expenses incurred by an “insured” or others to repair, replace, enhance, restore or maintain such property to prevent injury to a person or damage to property of others, whether on or away from an “insured location”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Property in an Insured's Care
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to “property damage” to property rented to, occupied or used by, or in the care of an “insured”. This exclusion does not apply to “property damage” caused by fire, smoke or explosion.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Workers' Compensation
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to “bodily injury” to any person eligible to receive any benefits voluntarily provided or required to be provided by an “insured” under any workers' compensation law, non-occupational disability law or occupational disease law.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Nuclear Liability
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to “bodily injury” or “property damage” for which an “insured” under this policy is also an insured under a nuclear energy liability policy, or would be an insured under that policy but for the exhaustion of its limit of liability.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage E Only > Injury to an Insured
clauses.text: Coverage E does not apply to “bodily injury” to you or an “insured” as defined in the Definitions. This exclusion also applies to any claim made or suit brought against you or an “insured” to repay or share damages with another person who may be obligated to pay damages because of “bodily injury” to an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage F Only
clauses.text: Coverage F does not apply to “bodily injury” to a “residence employee” if the “bodily injury” occurs off the “insured location” and does not arise out of or in the course of the “residence employee's” employment by an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage F Only
clauses.text: Coverage F does not apply to “bodily injury” to any person eligible to receive benefits voluntarily provided or required to be provided under any workers' compensation law, non-occupational disability law or occupational disease law.

clauses.heading: Section II - Exclusions > Coverage F Only
clauses.text: Coverage F does not apply to “bodily injury” to any person, other than a “residence employee” of an “insured”, regularly residing on any part of the “insured location”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Additional Coverages > Claim Expenses
clauses.text: We pay, in addition to the limits of liability: expenses we incur and costs taxed against an “insured” in any suit we defend; premiums on bonds required in a suit we defend, but not for bond amounts more than the Coverage E limit of liability; reasonable expenses incurred by an “insured” at our request, including actual loss of earnings, but not loss of other income, up to $250 per day, for assisting us in the investigation or defense of a claim or suit; and interest on the entire judgment which accrues after entry of the judgment and before we pay or tender, or deposit in court that part of the judgment which does not exceed the limit of liability that applies.

clauses.heading: Section II - Additional Coverages > First Aid Expenses
clauses.text: We will pay expenses for first aid to others incurred by an “insured” for “bodily injury” covered under this policy. We will not pay for first aid to an “insured”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Additional Coverages > Damage to Property of Others
clauses.text: We will pay, at replacement cost, up to $1,000 per “occurrence” for “property damage” to property of others caused by an “insured”, whether or not an “insured” is legally liable. We will not pay for “property damage” to the extent of any amount recoverable under Section I; caused intentionally by an “insured” who is 13 years of age or older; to property owned by an “insured”; to property owned by or rented to a tenant of an “insured” or a resident in your household; or arising out of a “business” engaged in by an “insured”, any act or omission in connection with a premises owned, rented or controlled by an “insured” other than the “insured location”, or the ownership, maintenance, occupancy, operation, use, loading or unloading of “aircraft”, hovercraft, watercraft or “motor vehicles”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Additional Coverages > Loss Assessment
clauses.text: We will pay up to $1,000 for your share of loss assessment charged against you, as owner or tenant of the “residence premises”, during the policy period by a corporation or association of property owners, when the assessment is made as a result of “bodily injury” or “property damage” not excluded under Section II, or liability for an act of a director, officer or trustee in that capacity, provided the director, officer or trustee is elected by the members and serves without deriving any income from the exercise of duties which are solely on behalf of the association.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Limit of Liability
clauses.text: Our total liability under Coverage E for all damages resulting from any one “occurrence” will not be more than the Coverage E limit of liability shown in the Declarations. This limit is the same regardless of the number of “insureds”, claims made or persons injured. All “bodily injury” and “property damage” resulting from any one accident or from continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions shall be considered to be the result of one “occurrence”. Our total liability under Coverage F for all medical expense payable for “bodily injury” to one person as the result of one accident will not be more than the Coverage F limit of liability shown in the Declarations.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Severability of Insurance
clauses.text: This insurance applies separately to each “insured”. This condition will not increase our limit of liability for any one “occurrence”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Duties After Occurrence
clauses.text: In case of an accident or “occurrence”, the “insured” will perform the following duties that apply; we have no duty to provide coverage under this policy if your failure to comply is prejudicial to us. Give written notice to us or our agent as soon as is practical, which sets forth the identity of the policy and named insured, reasonably available information on the time, place and circumstances of the accident or “occurrence”, and names and addresses of any claimants and witnesses; cooperate with us in the investigation, settlement or defense of any claim or suit; promptly forward to us every notice, demand, summons or other process relating to the accident or “occurrence”; and not, except at the “insured's” own cost, voluntarily make payment, assume obligation or incur expense other than for first aid to others at the time of the “bodily injury”.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Duties of an Injured Person - Coverage F
clauses.text: The injured person or someone acting for the injured person will give us written proof of claim, under oath if required, as soon as is practical, and authorize us to obtain copies of medical reports and records. The injured person will submit to a physical exam by a doctor of our choice when and as often as we reasonably require.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Payment of Claim - Coverage F
clauses.text: Payment under Coverage F is not an admission of liability by an “insured” or us.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Suit Against Us
clauses.text: No action can be brought against us unless there has been full compliance with all of the terms under Section II. No one will have the right to join us as a party to any action against an “insured”. No action with respect to Coverage E can be brought against us until the obligation of such “insured” has been determined by final judgment or agreement signed by us.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Bankruptcy of an Insured
clauses.text: Bankruptcy or insolvency of an “insured” will not relieve us of our obligations under this policy.

clauses.heading: Section II - Conditions > Other Insurance
clauses.text: This insurance is excess over other valid and collectible insurance except insurance written specifically to cover as excess over the limits of liability that apply in this policy.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Liberalization Clause
clauses.text: If we make a change which broadens coverage under this edition of our policy without additional premium charge, that change will automatically apply to your insurance as of the date we implement the change in your state, provided that this implementation date falls within 60 days prior to or during the policy period stated in the Declarations.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Waiver or Change of Policy Provisions
clauses.text: A waiver or change of a provision of this policy must be in writing by us to be valid. Our request for an appraisal or examination will not waive any of our rights.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Cancellation
clauses.text: You may cancel this policy at any time by returning it to us or by letting us know in writing of the date cancellation is to take effect.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Cancellation
clauses.text: We may cancel this policy only for the reasons stated below by letting you know in writing of the date cancellation takes effect. When you have not paid the premium, we may cancel at any time by letting you know at least 10 days before the date cancellation takes effect. When this policy has been in effect for less than 60 days and is not a renewal with us, we may cancel for any reason by letting you know at least 10 days before the date cancellation takes effect.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Cancellation
clauses.text: When this policy has been in effect for 60 days or more, or at any time if it is a renewal with us, we may cancel if there has been a material misrepresentation of fact which if known to us would have caused us not to issue the policy, or if the risk has changed substantially since the policy was issued. This can be done by letting you know at least 30 days before the date cancellation takes effect.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Cancellation
clauses.text: When this policy is canceled, the premium for the period from the date of cancellation to the expiration date will be refunded pro rata. If the return premium is not refunded with the notice of cancellation or when this policy is returned to us, we will refund it within a reasonable time after the date cancellation takes effect.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Nonrenewal
clauses.text: We may elect not to renew this policy. We may do so by delivering to you, or mailing to you at your mailing address shown in the Declarations, written notice at least 30 days before the expiration date of this policy. Proof of mailing will be sufficient proof of notice.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment of this policy will not be valid unless we give our written consent.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Subrogation
clauses.text: An “insured” may waive in writing before a loss all rights of recovery against any person. If not waived, we may require an assignment of rights of recovery for a loss to the extent that payment is made by us. If an assignment is sought, an “insured” must sign and deliver all related papers and cooperate with us. Subrogation does not apply to Coverage F or Section II Additional Coverage 3, Damage to Property of Others.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Death
clauses.text: If any person named in the Declarations or the spouse, if a resident of the same household, dies, we insure the legal representative of the deceased but only with respect to the premises and property of the deceased covered under the policy at the time of death, and “insured” includes an “insured” who is a member of your household at the time of your death, but only while a resident of the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Policy Period
clauses.text: This policy applies only to loss in Section I or “bodily injury” or “property damage” in Section II which occurs during the policy period. The policy period begins at 12:01 a.m. standard time on the effective date and ends at 12:01 a.m. standard time on the expiration date shown in the Declarations, at the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Sections I and II - Conditions > Concealment or Fraud
clauses.text: We provide coverage to no “insureds” under this policy if, whether before or after a loss, an “insured” has intentionally concealed or misrepresented any material fact or circumstance, engaged in fraudulent conduct, or made false statements relating to this insurance.
